utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm helping organize it! We're fixing small household items. Want to bring something to repair or lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's awesome! I've got a broken toaster I've been meaning to get fixed. I'd love to lend a hand too if you need extra help!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, do we need to bring any tools or just show up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Probably a good idea to bring basic tools if you have them, but no worries if not—we'll have some on hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, sounds good. I'll swing by the community center parking lot on Saturday. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, have you heard any updates about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: No, I haven't heard anything new. Are you sure it's still happening?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm not sure, honestly. Last I asked Oren, he said he forgot to check.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo! Are you planning to join the repair drive this Saturday? I'm also coordinating a pickup for items on Tuesday if you need help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm in. But my truck's dead—need a jump. You got cables?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm sure we can find some cables. I'll ask around—Sam might have a set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Pia, are you all set for the repair drive? Need any help getting your stuff together?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Honestly, I'm a bit worried about whether we have enough supplies. Do you know if everything's accounted for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Don't worry, Pia. I've got my tools and I'm sure we'll make do with what everyone brings. We always manage.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left the tools in the garage. Let me check.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Oren, the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I'm bringing my old blender!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, Saturday! I'll put it in my phone this time. Thanks, Vik!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey everyone, sorry I'm late. So, what's the first thing we need to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The repair drive starts at 10 AM sharp, as always. Let's get to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, Eli. So, do we have a list of materials we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, need any tools for the repair drive? I've got plenty in my shed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's really kind, Gus! Yeah, I'm planning to help out—Rosa said we're fixing things up at the community center this Saturday. Got any extra hammers I could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I've got a couple of hammers. I'll bring them over on Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Noah, before we dive in, could you clarify—are we working on community spaces like the playground, or is this more about fixing household items for neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hmm, good question... I think it's both? Or maybe just the playground? I can't quite remember.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's check with Mara or Dane to be sure—I recall they had more details about the scope.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm checking the inventory now. Do you have a list of materials we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I can ask around the neighborhood if anyone has spare tools or materials to donate. Let me know what we're missing!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn! We're short on screws and a few other small hardware items. Let me check my list for the exact counts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Opal, I'm still catching up on the repair drive details. Do you know what we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm not sure what we're short on, but I know it's at the Oak Street community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard Pia is worried about nails and lumber for the fences. Do you know if we have enough?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Rosa, thanks for coming by. It means a lot that everyone's helping out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, Uli. I wanted to let you know the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Sunday works for me. I'll be there, thanks for letting me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mara, have you had a chance to look over the inventory list? I'm worried we might be short on nails and lumber.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I checked the list, Pia; we're mainly short on small screws and solder, not nails or lumber.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief about the nails and lumber, but I'm still worried about those screws and solder. Do we have any leads on getting more?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Did you need any tools for the repair drive? I have some I could bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, the repair drive's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I'm bringing my old blender. Tools might be handy!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Saturday? I just heard about it from Cleo. Do you know if we still need nails and lumber for the fences?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Jules, could you tell me more about what this repair drive involves and what exactly needs repairing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's basically a community event where we collect broken household items and fix them up, instead of throwing them away. We could really use the help!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, I see. So we're fixing up small household items. Do you have a list of what needs repairing, or should we just bring in whatever we find broken?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I think it starts at 10am on Saturday. Should be a fun morning!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, 10am Saturday. I'll try to swing by if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Awesome, hope to see you there! They've got coffee too, so it'll be a good time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: From what I've gathered, we're trying to fix up shared neighborhood items. Gus has tools, and Cleo's checking what materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that's right—just let me know what you need, and I'll bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you have a list of what's available, or should we just come by and see?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at my porch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, thanks for the update! So it's Sunday at the community center now. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it starts at 10 a.m. and runs until 3 p.m. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Noah, could you maybe give me a hand with my fence during the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I thought that was last month—wait, or is it next weekend? I'm so confused.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, it's this coming Saturday. I just need a hand with one fence panel. Could you help?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira! Are you free this Saturday? We're organizing a repair drive at the community center and could use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive? I haven't heard much yet, but I can help spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, thanks Ira! I'll let you know the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam, I'm sorry, but I can't seem to recall where I put the repair drive. Did we already start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Not yet, Oren—it's still a bit before 10 AM. I was just about to help Leo jump-start his truck.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, before 10? That's good... I think. Wait, did we say 10 or 11? Sorry, I'll just check my watch... somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Alright, I'll check my stash for small screws and solder. How many of each did you say we need?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'd say at least a couple dozen assorted screws and a few spools of solder should be plenty.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, a couple dozen screws and a few spools. I'll go check my bins now and let you know what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Who's even organizing that?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I am. Got the parts list from the community board.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The community board? That's the one stapled to the old oak tree? You sure that's legit?
